reviews.text: Shari is a godsend to me and my dog Walter and has been helping us for 4+ years. She is reliable and I trust her completely to have a key to my home and to take care of my little guy. My neighbor can hear her interactions with Walter and comments how kind, gentle and patient she is with him (she carries him down the steps). I have recommended her to a few friends (cats and dogs) and they are pleased with her services too. I can’t recommend her enough!

I have been gladly using Westside Pet Sitters for over 15 years. Shari & her associates are all kind, reliable, trustworthy and fabulous with my kitties. I highly recommend and I am so thankful to have found them!

Shari has been our cat sitter for almost ten years! Not only does she care about her customers but cats love her. She even takes photos and videos of play time so we know the kitties got exercise and stimulation. She is our #1 recommended cat sitter!

I had an outstanding experience with Shari. She made the whole process easy, kept me comfortable while I was away, and clearly put in the effort to connect with my cat and give him great care. I’d absolutely use her services again and highly recommend her.

My cats absolutely LOVE Shari. She is the best cat sitter on the planet; she is always kind to me and my cat, professional, trustworthy, and truly cares about the animals she looks after. I always feel bad about leaving my cats behind when I travel, but I never have to worry about anything when I know that Shari is looking after them. She also sends me photos of them when she visits, which is comforting when I am away from home. I trust her completely and highly recommend her services. Trust me, you will be able to relax and enjoy being out of town knowing that your pets are safe and well cared for!

I couldn’t recommend Shari and Westside Pet Sitters more! Shari is incredibly reliable, knowledgeable, and caring. She takes such wonderful care of my cat, Sadie, whenever I’m away, and it’s obvious how much Sadie loves her. She plays with her, makes sure she’s comfortable and happy, feeds her, and keeps the litter box clean. She even gives her a Churu treat during each visit, which Sadie looks forward to!

What really sets Shari apart is how dependable she is and how much I trust her in my home. She has also helped me with several cat-related issues beyond regular cat sitting, which I’ve truly appreciated.

She sends the BEST daily photos and videos (examples included)! Truly some of my favorite pictures of my cat!! These daily recaps of each visit always help me feel connected and reassured while I’m gone. I can’t recommend Shari enough. She’s exceptional!

When your pets are family, having someone you trust look after them while you're away is so important, and in that regard there's no one we trust more than Shari. Kind, reliable, affordable, and with terrific pet photography skills to boot - we simply can't say enough nice things about Shari and her team.

Shari has been our cat sitter for almost three years and has done an amazing job with our two cats. She is extremely attentive, caring, and communicative, proactively keeping us informed and working with us to give our pets the best care possible. Having her as our sitter has kept our mind at ease many times while away from home, and I can't recommend her services enough.

Shari has been the only pet sitter I've used since adopting two kittens during the pandemic.  She's reliable, trustworthy, kind, and, most importantly, the cats love her.  I can't recommend her highly enough.  Your pets will be lucky to have her.

Shari has been caring for my cats (Roxy and now Zoey) for over 8 years. She is the best! Its always nerve-wracking leaving your pets at home alone, but I feel comfortable and confident every time I am out of town, knowing that Shari is there to care for and play with my girls. Zoey absolutely loves her, and she always sends the best pictures! I don't know what I would do without Westside Pet Sitters. Always timely, organized and terrific communication. Really A+++ service.

Shari has been our cat sitter for the past few years. We hate to leave our boys when traveling, but always feel better about it knowing that Shari will be taking care of them while we’re gone.
She is great about adapting to their little quirks & routines. They are both very comfortable with her, even from the very first interview visit. We always look forward to getting cute photos of the boys each day that Shari drops by.
She will even go the extra step
- she taped down the light switch when our naughty cat turned the fireplace switch on overnight.
We couldn’t recommend her services more!

Enjoy photos of our very happy boys playing with Shari!

Shari has taken care of our two kitties with love and attention since 2021. We have been extremely happy with her and her team’s services! Our kitties are always very glad to see her and we know that she makes sure they are loved when we are away traveling! I recommend Westside Pet Sitters without reservation😊

I highly recommend Westside Pet Sitters. Our family has hired them regularly over the last few years, and Shari is always great. She's reliable, always sends photos of our cat after each visit, plays with her, and keeps an eye on any issue that might come up. We love that she also has additional cat sitters in her group in case something comes up with her (which hasn't happened). This is a professionally run business, and we really do recommend her highly.

Shari and her team have been nothing but phenomenal. Shari and my cat have developed such a special bond and she treats my pet (and all in her care) with such kindess and attention. I feel completely comfortable leaving my cat in her and her team's care. They're responsive, thoughtful, and true animal lovers. I can't recommend Westside Pet Sitters highly enough!
Shari and her team always take great care of my cats. She even managed to win the trust of my very skittish tortie. Highly recommend!

I hired Shari / Westside Pet Sitters this year to look in on my senior cat while I'm away on short work trips or overnights. I was immediately impressed that Shari came over to do an initial meet and greet with myself and my cat so she could meet my cat and chat with me about all of my cat's needs, food/treat/play preferences, hiding spots, and anything else she should be aware of when she visits. Other larger companies I've used in the past only had me fill out a form online so it was a nice experience getting to meet the actual person would be taking care of my beloved pet whenever I was away. Shari is very communicative and always texts to confirm my upcoming scheduled visits 1-2 days prior, which is appreciated. She also sends a text update during her visit to confirm my cat is OK and cared for. Shari always sends along a photo or little video from her visit which is also nice peace of mind for me. I can trust Shari to give my cat proper care with feeding and cleaning out the litter box and even playing with her a bit (when the cat is up for it). I also find Shari's pricing very fair and comparable. Overall, a wonderful service with a caring professional at the helm. I will continue to hire Shari as long as I live in the area. Thank you for the wonderful care!

My partner and I have been lucky to have Shari look after our cat periodically during our travels over the last two years. She is friendly, trustworthy, knowledgeable and passionate about animals, and has sent us many timely updates and photos of our beloved cat while we were away. She has always been so reliable and I can't recommend her enough!

Shari was recommended to me by a fellow cat lover when I moved to LA two years ago. She won my shy cats' trust right away and sends pictures and a report every day. She's so reliable and knowledgeable that I don't worry a bit about leaving my cats in her care.

I’m so relieved to have found Shari! We adopted a very shy and skittish adult kitty six months ago and Shari has been very patient in gaining our cat’s trust. When we go out of town, she sends notes and photos to let us know all is well - even if our cat decides to be antisocial - which is such a comfort! We recently moved a few miles further away and luckily Shari agreed to continue visiting when we’re out of town… the continuity is important for a nervous cat, and she is now able to coax our girl out for treats and pets! I hate leaving our kitty alone but feel better knowing she has Shari to visit her, and have already recommended her to others!

I have been a client for just under one year and could not be happier.  They have arrived as expected every single time.  I get pictures of my kids on their walks.  Shari has replied last minute and fit me in when I have changes to my schedule.  I have 2 small dogs who get walks and big 3 cats who get attention.  I could not be happier.  The service is excellent.  The billing is transparent and reasonable.  I have had 15 or so visits so far and zero complaints.
this service is very dependable, safe and gives you a peace of mind knowing your furry friends are taken care of

Shari has been my go-to cat sitter since I moved to Los Angeles in 2017, and she’s been absolutely wonderful. She’s the most reliable, caring pet sitter anyone could ask for. She is also an amazing photographer, sending great footage of my pets while I'm away.

Shari truly cares about the well-being of the animals she looks after. When my cat Oscar (RIP) was sick, she would check in regularly to see how he was doing. When my kitten developed FIP, she sent thoughtful messages to check on him too. It’s clear she loves what she does, and I trust her completely with my pets and my home. I can’t recommend her highly enough.

Shari (and her crew when extremely booked )  have been taking care of my 2 fur babies for almost 4 years! She is the most amazing human and my cats absolutely adore her! I have never felt so safe leaving my animals with someone, I can not praise this company more! 12/10
